description_en: Retrieves a list of available application instance specifications
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceSpecifications接口获取应用实例规格信息
name: DescribeInstanceSpecifications

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. Valid values:

2xx: The request is successful.

3xx: The request is redirected.

4xx: The request is invalid.

5xx: A server error occurs
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

Enable.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance specification is available. Valid values:

true: available

false: unavailable
Enable.description_zh:
实例是否可用。取值说明如下：

true：可用。
false：不可用

Id.description_en: The ID of the instance specification

SpecInfo.description_en: The name of the instance specification

Version.description_en: The version of the instance specification

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

The ErrorCode parameter is not returned if the request is successful.

The ErrorCode parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section of this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码目录

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request is successful, success is returned.

If the request fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance specifications are obtained. Valid values:

true: The instance specifications are obtained.

false: The instance specifications fail to be obtained
Success.description_zh:
获取实例规格是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：获取成功。
false：获取失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of a request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
